h1: Custom Hit Mints for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom Hit mints in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for branding with logo imprints on tins or wrappers.
introHtml: Hit mints are a classic promotional product, known for their smooth buttermint and peppermint varieties. When you choose custom Hit mints, you’re selecting a trusted brand that recipients recognize and enjoy. Perfect for corporate gifts, event giveaways, or client appreciation, these mints can be imprinted with your logo on tins or individually wrapped pieces. Offer a refreshing treat that keeps your brand top of mind.
heroAltText: Assorted custom Hit mints in branded tins and wrappers for corporate gifts and events
